patch_description: Keeps the direct-link calibration that has performed well, while making relay rewards more selective and demand-adaptive. For each positive-demand OD pair, it ranks candidate two-hop relays using both leg affinity and relay pressure, then retains a small set of alternatives—more for heavier demands. This preserves useful routing interactions without creating a dense coupling graph. The penalty weight is retained at 2.0; degree penalties themselves remain entirely with the evaluator.
